name: 随心log
subtitle: Journal, habits, small steps
promotionalText: Keep a thought, a photo, or a small step forward. A quiet personal space for everyday records and reflection.
description:
Suixinlog is a personal space to capture life, organize actions and reflect on your progress.

CAPTURE A MOMENT
Save text, selected photos, or both. A title, tag or category can wait. Use the system share menu to bring in text, images and website sources.

REVISIT YOUR TIMELINE
Browse life in time order, search earlier records, and organize with lightweight tags and links. Pin an entry, add a follow-up thought, or write a weekly reflection.

MAKE ROOM FOR ACTION
Keep habits, check-ins, goals and lightweight tasks together. Tasks include lists, fixed calendar repeats and optional reminders. Important dates support Gregorian and Chinese lunar calendars and home-screen widgets.

NOTICE EVERYDAY CHANGES
Manually record weight, sleep and time investment. Save dated CNY asset and liability balance snapshots to review household net worth. These are personal records, not medical diagnosis, investment advice or bank-connected services.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR DATA
Core records are stored on your device and work offline, with no developer account required. Opt into iCloud sync when you choose, and export a full backup containing your records and original images.

iCloud sync requires an available iCloud account, network and storage; delays or protective pauses can occur. Keep independent backups. Full backups can import only into an empty database and do not merge existing records. Exported ZIP and CSV files are not encrypted; store them securely.

For iPhone, in English and Simplified Chinese. Camera, notification and alarm permissions are requested for features you choose to use; alarms depend on OS support. No ads, in-app purchases or subscriptions.

Leave yourself something to remember.
reviewNotes:
No developer account or sign-in is required. Core recording works offline. The app is a private personal journal, not a public social platform.

1. Open Record (third tab), enter text or select an image, then Save. Open Timeline to review it. Library provides search and organization.
2. Growth opens habits, goals, weight, sleep, time investment, important dates and household net worth. Financial values are manually entered CNY balances; there are no bank connections, financial services or investment advice. Health information is self-entered and is not medical diagnosis or a HealthKit integration.
3. Optional iCloud sync is OFF by default. Settings → iCloud Sync explains the connection and requires explicit confirmation. It uses the device user's own iCloud private database. Core features work without iCloud. Sync may wait or pause for account, network, conflict or data-integrity conditions.
4. Settings → Data Transfer exports an unencrypted full backup. Import is allowed only into an empty local database; it does not merge into or erase a nonempty database. Please use a fresh test environment if testing import.
5. Reminders and alarms are optional and need system permission. Alarms are available only on supported OS versions. Important-date widgets read selected local App Group content.
6. Settings → Privacy and Support provides the bundled privacy policy and support information offline.

The release is free, with no advertising, in-app purchases or subscriptions. No demo mode, reviewer credentials or special hardware is required. Please do not erase production iCloud data for testing.
